serverInfo.name: sap.mcp/sfodata
serverInfo.title: sfodata
serverInfo.description: MCP server for the sfodata service.

tools.name: get_metadata_sfodata
tools.title: get_metadata_sfodata
tools.description:
Get metadata of the OData service with optional filtering to reduce token consumption.
Returns the metadata in XML format, which can be used to discover available entities and their properties.
Call this endpoint every time before you call other tools to ensure understanding of the schema.
Based on the metadata, you can dynamically create an OData request.

Use filtering parameters to get specific metadata sections. Without parameters, this tool returns the complete XML metadata (which might be huge).
Only use the specified enum values for the filtering parameters.

tools.name: batch_for_sfodata
tools.title: batch_for_sfodata
tools.description: Execute multiple OData operations in a single batch request using the $batch endpoint. This allows you to combine multiple tool calls into one HTTP request, improving efficiency when performing multiple operations.

tools.name: list_competencytype_for_sfodata
tools.title: list_CompetencyType_for_sfodata
tools.description: Retrieve a list of entities from the CompetencyType collection in the sfodata service. Supports OData query options for filtering, sorting, ranking ($top), skipping ($skip), expanding related entities, counting, selecting specific properties. Only use attributes in the query options that are specified in the metadata. If the structure of the entity is not known, call get_metadata_sfodata tool first to get the metadata.

tools.name: get_competencytype_for_sfodata
tools.title: get_CompetencyType_for_sfodata
tools.description: Retrieve a single entity by its key from the CompetencyType collection in the sfodata service. Provide the key property value(s) to identify the specific entity to retrieve. Supports OData query options for selecting specific properties ($select), expanding related entities ($expand). If the structure of the entity is not known, call get_metadata_sfodata tool first to get the metadata.

tools.name: count_competencytype_for_sfodata
tools.title: count_CompetencyType_for_sfodata
tools.description: Get the total count of entities in the CompetencyType collection in the sfodata service. Supports OData $filter to count only entities matching specific criteria. Use this when you need to determine the total number of entities without retrieving the actual data. If you need to understand the available filter properties, call get_metadata_sfodata tool first to get the metadata.
